failure_ledger.failure: RuntimeEvent accepted schema versions other than v1 because schema_version was an unconstrained integer.
failure_ledger.hypothesis: An unsupported event version can appear hash-valid while bypassing the declared v1 compatibility contract.
failure_ledger.minimal_change: Constrain RuntimeEvent.schema_version to Literal[1] and add a future-version rejection fixture.
failure_ledger.evidence: P3 source review and the P3-F11 replay/version fault specification identified the unconstrained field.
failure_ledger.limitation: This validates the event envelope only; it does not migrate or interpret a future schema.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Restore the permissive field only if a separately versioned migration and compatibility policy is approved.

failure_ledger.failure: An opt-in scientific task could complete after evidence and validation without a green phase-close record, and terminal claims were not checked for record closure.
failure_ledger.hypothesis: A scientific success must bind an explicit green phase close and resolve every referenced evidence/validation ID before completion.
failure_ledger.minimal_change: Add optional phase-close and claim inputs to RuntimeController.complete and gate only explicit scientific tasks.
failure_ledger.evidence: P3-F09 and the deterministic fault inventory isolate missing claim closure and phase-close bypasses.
failure_ledger.limitation: The gate does not make a claim true; it only prevents an unresolved or red record from being called complete.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Remove the opt-in completion extensions if replay or legacy CLI tests show a semantic regression.

failure_ledger.failure: A recorded approval invalidation or budget exhaustion did not independently prevent scientific completion.
failure_ledger.hypothesis: Any active-task invalidation or exhausted active budget is a deterministic red completion gate.
failure_ledger.minimal_change: Add active-task approval-invalidation and budget-exhaustion checks to the opt-in scientific completion rules.
failure_ledger.evidence: P3-F10 and P3-F12 fixture definitions plus the P2 reducer-state review.
failure_ledger.limitation: Executor-side one-shot consumption is still outside this phase and no action was dispatched.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Retain the records but remove only the completion checks if a future executor proves a stricter authoritative gate.
